+---

+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: 'Tool foundation: add Extras Operations, the tool context and corrective output'
+---
+## What
+Prepare the main target `FoundationModelsCodeContext` for operation-based FoundationModels tools. The user decided: the tool code goes in the one main target (examples and integration tests stay separate targets), there are three tools (`code_search`, `code_navigation`, `code_index`), and each tool operates on one `CodeContext`.
+
+Framework facts (FoundationModelsExtras `d0048eb`, product `Operations`): operations are `@Generable @Operation(verb:noun:description:)` structs that conform to `OperationDefinition` with one shared `Context: Sendable` and `func execute(in context: Context) async throws -> Output` (`Output: Encodable & Sendable`). `OperationTool<Context>(name:description:context:operations:)` fuses them. Parameters can be only `String`, `Int`, `Double`, `Bool`, arrays and optionals. `@Guide(.anyOf)` values are NOT enforced at dispatch. `OperationError.executionFailed` is rethrown and stops the model's turn; FoundationModelsSkills returns recoverable errors as a corrective output instead (`FoundationModelsSkills/Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Operations/OperationSupport.swift:99-125`).
+
+- [ ] `Package.swift`: change `// swift-tools-version: 6.1` to `6.2` (Extras requires 6.2). Add `.package(url: "git@github.com:swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsExtras.git", branch: "main")` with a comment in the same style as the Ranker entry, and add `.product(name: "Operations", package: "FoundationModelsExtras")` to the `FoundationModelsCodeContext` target.
+- [ ] Add `Sources/FoundationModelsCodeContext/Tools/CodeContextOperating.swift`: an internal `protocol CodeContextOperating: Sendable` with the `CodeContext` methods that the tools call (all public query methods listed in `CodeContext.swift` lines 309–515), and `extension CodeContext: CodeContextOperating {}`. This removes the `Connection` generic from the tool context, so tests can use `CodeContext<FakeLanguageServerConnection>`.
+- [ ] Add `Sources/FoundationModelsCodeContext/Tools/CodeContextToolContext.swift`: `public struct CodeContextToolContext: Sendable` that holds `let operating: any CodeContextOperating`, with an internal init.
+- [ ] Add `Sources/FoundationModelsCodeContext/Tools/ToolSupport.swift`: (1) `enum ToolOutcome<Success: Encodable & Sendable>: Encodable, Sendable` with `.success(Success)` (encodes the value) and `.corrective(String)` (encodes a bare JSON string); (2) `func correctiveMessage(for error: CodeContextError) -> String?` that returns a message for the recoverable cases `.notFound`, `.pattern`, `.query` and `nil` for the others; (3) `func parseChoice<T: RawRepresentable>(_ raw: String?, as: T.Type, parameter: String) -> ToolOutcome<T>`-style helper that turns a string into an enum case or a corrective message that lists the allowed values.
+- [ ] Write every comment in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `swift package dump-package | rg -c FoundationModelsExtras` gives a count; `swift package show-dependencies --format json | rg -c -i foundationmodelsrouter` gives no output (Extras does not add Router).
+- [ ] `CodeContext` conforms to `CodeContextOperating`.
+- [ ] A corrective outcome encodes as a JSON string, and a success outcome encodes as the value.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] New `Tests/FoundationModelsCodeContextTests/ToolSupportTests.swift`: `successOutcomeEncodesTheValue`, `correctiveOutcomeEncodesABareString`, `parseChoiceAcceptsEachRawValue`, `parseChoiceRejectsAnUnknownValueWithTheAllowedList`, `recoverableErrorsGiveACorrectiveMessage`.
+- [ ] `swift build` exits 0, and `swift build --package-path IntegrationTests --build-tests` exits 0.
+- [ ] `swift format lint -r --strict Sources Tests Examples IntegrationTests Package.swift` exits 0.
+- [ ] `swift test` exits 0.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
